title: Meet our new logo
summary: We've refreshed the Precip logo: three falling raindrops that read clearly at every size — less abstract, more literal.
body_markdown:
## A clearer rainstorm


If you’ve opened the app or website lately, you may have noticed something different in the corner.


Our old mark was a circle of rain droplets — the view from below, looking up at the sky while rain fell all around you. We loved the idea. In practice it read more like a pinwheel or a sunburst than rain, especially at favicon and home-screen size.


The new mark is more literal: three raindrops, angled the way rain actually falls. Same weather, less explaining.


## A nod for the people who know


Real raindrops in free fall aren’t the cartoon teardrops we all draw as kids. Aerodynamics flatten the bottom. The icon still uses the shape everyone recognizes as rain — because it has to read instantly on a home screen. Look closer at the wordmark, though: the dot on the i is a tiny real raindrop, flattened bottom and all. A quiet thank-you to anyone who’s ever cared enough to check.


## What stayed the same


This isn’t a rebrand. We’re still Precip. The blue is still Precip Blue (` #155EEF` ). The wordmark is still the same name you’ve always known. We simplified the mark and refreshed the lockups, avatars, and favicons so everything reads clearly from a phone home screen to a press kit.


## Where to get the files


If you write about us, embed our data, or put Precip on a slide deck, grab the latest assets from our[brand guidelines](https://precip.ai/brand) page — SVGs and PNGs for the lockup, mark, social avatar, and “Powered by Precip” badges, plus simple do’s and don’ts.


Thanks for sticking with us as we keep measuring the rain — and looking a little sharper while we do it.
